protocol: Post-5B outcome-blind attacking movement prominence refinement
scientific_question: Can the existing attacker-only speed-valley segmentation be refined using valley prominence so that meaningful over-fragmentation is reduced without materially increasing merging/direction failures or collapsing lower-speed movement coverage?

game2_eligibility.judgment: untouched for this specific segmentation outcome and eligible as held-out validation
game2_eligibility.evidence: Tracked history contains Game 2 Phase 4 defensive-geometry validation but no Game 2 attacker-movement segmentation, prominence calculation, refined episode count, or refinement result.

historical_method_a.position_smoothing: centered 7-frame rolling mean of x and y with complete support
historical_method_a.speed: Euclidean consecutive-smoothed-position difference divided by observed frame interval
historical_method_a.candidate_valley: maximal flat speed run no higher than both immediate neighbors and strictly lower than at least one; use midpoint
historical_method_a.close_valley_resolution: after prominence filtering, retain lower-speed candidate; earlier candidate on exact tie
historical_method_a.episode: consecutive retained valleys inside one eligible block

prominence.scope: entire eligible player block; no finite local window parameter
prominence.definition: standard topographic peak prominence applied to negative speed. For valley i, find the nearest strictly deeper speed valley on each side, using the eligible-block edge when none exists; let L_i and R_i be the maximum speed encountered from i through those left/right limits. Prominence is min(L_i, R_i) - v_i.
operation_order: for nonzero candidates compute standard prominence within the eligible block
remove candidates below the configured prominence threshold
apply the historical 1.0-second consolidation to remaining candidates
form consecutive-valley episodes and apply the historical 1.0-second numerical-stability minimum
prominence.implementation_note: Use a deterministic implementation mathematically equivalent to standard peak prominence; SciPy is not an explicit project dependency and is not required by this protocol.

candidate_rationale: 0.0 is the historical baseline. The three nonzero candidates form a closed modest-to-strong ladder in physical speed units, chosen before any refined output and not extendable after execution.

fragmentation.success: relative reduction from the documented 42.22% operational baseline >= 20%

merging_direction.success: candidate rate <= 3.97%; this is the frozen stricter operational cap

lower_speed_coverage.formula: count(peak_speed_mps < 5.5 and displacement_m >= 3.0) / count(all candidate episodes)
lower_speed_coverage.denominator_note: The historical 41.00% is an all-episode joint share, not a conditional share among episodes with displacement >= 3 m. The all-episode denominator is retained.

implementation_qc: historical 0.0 branch reproduces all saved Method A episode identities and diagnostics
every retained nonzero boundary is a historical candidate valley meeting the configured prominence
no episode crosses a period, unsupported-coordinate, BALL OUT, or SET PIECE boundary
no interpolation, clipping, winsorization, speed cap, or defensive/outcome input

candidate_selection.eligibility: nonzero candidate must pass fragmentation, merging/direction, lower-speed coverage, and implementation/QC criteria
candidate_selection.none_eligible: select no candidate; classify B or C mechanically
candidate_selection.one_eligible: select that candidate provisionally subject to visual coherence
candidate_selection.multiple_eligible: select the lowest nonzero prominence provisionally subject to visual coherence
candidate_selection.rationale: smallest intervention in the historical method
candidate_selection.visual_override: visual audit cannot rescue failed quantitative criteria; a visual coherence failure prevents advancement to held-out validation

classification.A: At least one nonzero candidate passes every quantitative and implementation criterion; the least-restrictive eligible candidate passes the predeclared visual coherence review.
classification.B: At least one nonzero candidate achieves the >=20% fragmentation reduction, but no candidate passes the complete quantitative/QC/visual package.
classification.C: No nonzero candidate achieves the >=20% fragmentation reduction, or the refinement is unstable, uninterpretable, or fails implementation QC.
classification.visual_coherence: All displayed refined boundaries trace to qualifying valleys; no displayed episode violates an eligibility block; removed/retained boundaries are interpretable in every team-period stratum; and no repeated unanticipated failure mode appears across both teams and both periods. Any ambiguity withholds A.

visual_audit.source: historical Game 1 Method A table and the future selected candidate only
visual_audit.core_chronological: Within each team x period stratum of n rows, sort historical episodes by start_s, numeric player, start_frame, end_frame and select zero-based indices floor((n-1)*q+0.5) for q in {1/6, 3/6, 5/6}.
visual_audit.fragmentation: Within each team x period stratum, select the earliest historical diag_fragmentation_any episode by start_s, numeric player, start_frame, end_frame.
visual_audit.merging_risk: Within each team x period stratum, select the longest historical diag_merging_any episode, breaking ties by start_s, numeric player, start_frame, end_frame.
visual_audit.deduplication: Take the union by historical episode_id and retain all selection-reason labels.
visual_audit.display: attacking/player trajectory and speed only; compare historical and selected-prominence boundaries; no defender or outcome overlay

tracking_qc.treatment: B — preserve the historical primary scope because no automatic numeric support rule is frozen
tracking_qc.primary: do not silently exclude or repair tracking intervals
tracking_qc.confirmed_sensitivity_flag: Home Player 10 period 1 raw-support interval frames 2911-2945; report primary metrics unchanged and a separate diagnostic sensitivity excluding episodes whose required raw/smoothing support intersects this interval
tracking_qc.other_tail_flags: Home 3 and Away 22 maxima remain descriptive QC flags and are not automatically excluded without a frozen support rule
tracking_qc.prohibition: prominence must not be interpreted as repairing identity or trajectory discontinuities

allowed: player own speed and episode geometry
global BALL OUT and SET PIECE exclusions already used historically

heldout_validation.prerequisite: Game 1 result classifies A and the selected rule is frozen before any Game 2 segmentation output
tests: fragmentation rate decreases relative to the Game 2 no-prominence baseline
all-episode lower-speed displacement>=3 m share remains >=90% of the Game 2 no-prominence share
deterministic Game 2 visual sample passes the same coherence review

stopping_rule: After this closed prominence ladder, do not add direction splitting, another refinement, changed duration thresholds, changed valley spacing, or changed smoothing because a criterion is narrowly missed. If prominence fails, stop and reassess the segmentation construct conceptually before another implementation.
